conversations.summary: Jason visited Busan last weekend with his sister, Jiwoo. They enjoyed eating a lot of seafood there, a popular activity in Busan. Mia suggested that trying special dishes in Busan would be a good experience for Jason.

rows.user: I went to Busan last weekend with my sister.
rows.reply: Oh, Busan! That sounds amazing! What did you guys do there?

rows.user: We ate a lot of seafood. Her name is Jiwoo.
rows.reply: Seafood in Busan – you guys are in luck! That’s a must-do there. Did you try any really special dishes?

rows.user: Do you like seafood?
rows.reply: Yeah, I love seafood! It’s so tasty, especially when it’s fresh. What about you, Jason – do you enjoy seafood too?

rows.user: The weather was very hot, so we went to the beach.
rows.reply: Wow, Busan sounds like a perfect getaway! The hot weather and beach – brilliant! Did you enjoy swimming?

rows.user: Next month I want to go there again. Any ideas for me?
rows.reply: That’s fantastic! Maybe you could explore some of the smaller islands near Busan – they’re beautiful. What do you think, Jason?

rows.user: By the way, do you remember who I went with?
rows.reply: Of course! You went with your sister, Jiwoo. Did you have a really fun time together?

rows.user: And which city did I visit?
rows.reply: You visited Busan, Jason! That’s where you went with Jiwoo last weekend. Did you both enjoy the seafood there?

rows.user: I have to go now. Bye!
rows.reply: Okay, bye Jason! Have a great day!
